data.description:
## Description

**What**: Check PR #65 and PR #62 diffs into tests/fixtures/review-convergence/<pr-id>.diff with prior-cycle findings JSON. Implement test harness that runs the new pipeline against each fixture and asserts: (a) RESUSTAIN_OF X with proximity overlap triggers exactly one arbiter dispatch on the same finding ID; (b) NEW_INTRODUCED on overlapping/proximate lines without escape_rationale is rejected and re-dispatched; (c) NEW_PRE_EXISTING auto-downgrades unless prior was important+; (d) DOWNGRADE_TO without valid named_rebuttal is reclassified as ACCEPT_DEFENSE. Plus 5 SHA-pinned single-cycle PRs from last 90 days as regression fixtures (must remain single-cycle, equivalent findings modulo new relation fields).
**Why**: SC6 validation. Deterministic, reproducible test against the canonical multi-cycle PRs that motivated this epic.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - PR #65 and PR #62 diffs + prior findings JSON checked into tests/fixtures/review-convergence/
  - Test harness asserts (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) on both fixtures
  - 5 single-cycle regression fixtures show equivalent findings + cycle_count=1
  - Fidelity tolerance for CI deep-tier (one-band severity drift max) verified
  OUT:
  - All Phase 1 + Phase 2 stories

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the test harness against fixtures shows the new pipeline converges in <=2 cycles for PR #65 and PR #62 and preserves single-cycle behavior on the easy-path regression set
  ← Satisfies: "Migration via best-effort file-path binding, fixture-based validation, and forward telemetry"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Fixture files frozen at SHA-pin; refresh via dedicated fixture-refresh story if reviewer prompts change post-launch

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As the review pipeline, I am validated against fixture-based reproductions of PR #65, PR #62, and 5 SHA-pinned single-cycle PRs
